input: x = L2-normalised image embedding from manifest.vision_encoder, concatenated with features.names in order

features.spec: Computed after flattening transparency onto white (as for the embedding). log_aspect = ln(width / height) of the image. Then resize the RGB image to 128x128 (bilinear); a pixel is white when min(R, G, B) >= 245; white_frac = share of white pixels; white_border_frac = share of white pixels among those within 8 px of the edge.

usage: p = softmax(x @ weight.T + bias) over classes; group probability = sum of p over groups[g]; predict the argmax group, but if it is not fallback.group and its probability < fallback.min_confidence, predict fallback.group
